source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: F3a: the state transitions of the gauge and the radar during their enter, the graph, the tree, the treemap and the sankey, and the sankey's selectchanged. A case sets `option` at T0 and settles -- a live one sets it at T1 instead (sample 0 is that setOption's flush, no further frame) -- then at each sample t of samplesMs: the events at t (move: handler.mousemove at x,y; click: mousemove, mousedown, mouseup, click at x,y; out: mousemove at 3,3; action: dispatchAction), then NOW = T1 + t and one zr.animation.update(), then the record. Element keys as advchart-states-misc.json (plus a radar polyline's / polygon's shape.points, flat); map: the port's part {s, row (inner index), part}: host, label, peer, rarea, rsym<j>, part<k>, edge, edgepart<k>, edgelabel. published: the chart's events per sample; selection as states-misc.

clock.note: each case on a clock of its own, later than every earlier one (the generation runs twice): only times relative to its t0 are written; T1 = t0 + T1Offset

cases.note: the option set at T1 (the enter running: the pointer turns, the arc grows); hover the pointer at 100 -- saveCurrentToNormalState saves the rotation's end into the normal state; out at 300 -- the way back to normal tweens the rotation from where it is (the enter's track stopped)
the same on the progress arc: its endAngle is saved and tweened back
a radar entering (its points out of the centre): hover a symbol at 150, out at 400 -- the polyline's and the polygon's points saved and tweened back
hover node b at 0: its path scales to _sizeX * 1.1 (absolute), the fill lifts, the label stays; hover the edge b-c at 500 (the line's stroke lifts, its arrow and label with it); out at 1000
emphasis.scale 1.6 on an oblong symbol ([24, 12]): scaleX 12 * 1.6, scaleY 6 * 1.6
focus adjacency: hovering c keeps b, d and the two edges, the rest blurs (opacity 0.1 of each); out at 500
the option set at T1 (the symbols popping in): hover node a at 500 -- saveTo puts the pop-in's scale end into the normal state, emphasis scales from where it is; out at 700
hover node a at 0: its path to 6 * 1.1, the fill lifts; out at 500
focus descendant: hovering a blurs root, b, b1, c and their edges; out at 500
the option set at T1: hover node a at 550 (its group has arrived at 500, its symbol still pops in -- linear 700); out at 800
hover leaf a1 at 0 (its content and background lift), then leaf c at 500; out at 1000
focus descendant on a parent: hovering a's background keeps a1, a2, the rest blurs (the blur colour); out at 500
roam: hover leaf a1 at 0, the view pans (treemapMove, the root moved 20 px right) at 150 while the lift runs -- the render keeps the elements and their states; out at 700
hover node b at 0 (its fill lifts), then the band a-c at 500 (its opacity to 0.5, the fill lifts); out at 1000
focus adjacency: hovering b keeps a, d and the bands a-b, b-d; the rest blurs; out at 500
selectedMode multiple: click node a at 0, the band b-d at 400, node a again at 800 -- selectchanged lists every data (node and edge) of the series
